summary: WITH PRINT - a professional 2-page printing service website for college students featuring pricing tables, payment integration via PhonePe/UPI, and order confirmation system
architectural_notes: 2-page website structure: Home and Payment pages
Payment integration: PhonePe QR code with UPI ID 9392673014@axl
Customer workflow: View pricing → Proceed to Payment → Pay via UPI → Submit confirmation form → Success message
Form captures: Name, Email, Phone, UTR/Transaction ID, Payment screenshot
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- PhonePe payment QR code for UPI ID 9392673014@axl (phonepe-qr.dim_400x400.png)

existing_features.title: Create a home page displaying business name 'WITH PRINT' prominently at the top
Display pricing table on home page showing B&W printing at ₹1 per page and color printing at ₹10 per page
Add delivery information section to home page stating delivery timeline
Display contact phone number with call timing information on home page
Add 'Proceed to Payment' button on home page that navigates to payment page
Create payment page displaying PhonePe QR code image for scanning
Display UPI ID '9392673014@axl' and name 'Kairamkonda Upendra Devi' on payment page
Add step-by-step payment instructions on payment page: (1) Open PhonePe/Google Pay/Paytm, (2) Scan QR code, (3) Enter amount, (4) Complete payment, (5) Take screenshot, (6) Fill form
Create payment confirmation form with fields: Name (text input), Email (email input), Phone Number (tel input), UTR/Transaction ID (text input), Payment Screenshot (file upload)
Add blue-colored Submit button to payment confirmation form
Display success message after form submission: '✅ Payment received successfully. We will verify and start printing. You will get delivery tomorrow morning.'
Implement routing for 2-page structure: home page (/) and payment page (/payment)

Apply a clean, professional design theme with a modern, trustworthy aesthetic suitable for a college printing service. Use warm, approachable colors (avoid blue & purple unless in small accents). Ensure consistent typography, adequate spacing, and clear visual hierarchy across both pages.

Payment page with PhonePe QR code, UPI ID (9392673014@axl), step-by-step payment instructions, and confirmation form (Name, Email, Phone, UTR, Screenshot upload)
Success message after form submission confirming order will be delivered tomorrow morning
